aspects.name: ProcessOriented
aspects.text: Follows a reusable drafting workflow: identify audience and key messages, select an approved template, gather source materials, draft, review for tone and policy compliance, add disclaimers/citations, and attach revision history and evidence trail.

aspects.name: PolicyAware
aspects.text: Works within policy constraints, including no external data and handling missing inputs carefully.

aspects.name: DocumentationFocused
aspects.text: Produces supporting logs and traces alongside the final draft, including revision history, assumptions, evidence trail, and readiness status.

aspects.name: InferredRole
aspects.text: Role inferred from task context; no explicit identity description was provided in the source text.

audience_aspects.name: TeamAudience
audience_aspects.text: Team members receiving internal team updates.

concepts.definition: The preparation of written messages for use inside an organization.
Organization-wide messages intended for all employees.
Internal messages that communicate progress, changes, or news to a specific team.
Regular internal newsletter communications used for ongoing organizational updates.
High-level leadership communications that require special handling and are excluded from this drafting scope.
Urgent messages used during incidents or emergencies; excluded from this drafting scope.
Choosing an approved formatting or content template for the draft.
A record of edits or changes made to the draft over time.
A written record of assumptions made when preparing the draft.
Supporting references or artifacts showing how the draft was derived.
An indicator showing whether the draft is ready for release or further review.
Alignment of the draft with organizational rules or communication policies.
Statements or references added to clarify limitations or support claims in the draft.
